import pandas as pd

# File paths for source data
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/test_1.csv"

# Load source tables
df_17 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
df_15 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)

# Rename columns in df_15 to match target schema suffix "_15"
df_15_renamed = df_15.rename(columns={
    'Happiness Rank': 'Happiness_Rank_15',
    'Happiness Score': 'Happiness_Score_15',
    'Standard Error': 'Standard_Error_15',
    'Economy (GDP per Capita)': 'Economy_15',
    'Family': 'Family_15',
    'Health (Life Expectancy)': 'Life_Expectancy_15',
    'Freedom': 'Freedom_15',
    'Trust (Government Corruption)': 'Trust_15',
    'Generosity': 'Generosity_15',
    'Dystopia Residual': 'Dystopia_15'
})

# df_17 columns already mostly match target schema suffix "_17"
# Just ensure columns are exactly as target expects
df_17_renamed = df_17.rename(columns={
    'Country': 'Country',
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Happiness_Rank_17',
    'Happiness_Score_17': 'Happiness_Score_17',
    'Whisker_High_17': 'Whisker_High_17',
    'Whisker_Low_17': 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17': 'Economy_17',
    'Family_17': 'Family_17',
    'Life_Expectancy_17': 'Life_Expectancy_17',
    'Freedom_17': 'Freedom_17',
    'Generosity_17': 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17': 'Trust_17',
    'Dystopia_17': 'Dystopia_17'
})

# The target table requires 'Region' column.
# df_17 does NOT have Region, df_15 has Region.
# Join on 'Country' to bring Region from df_15 to df_17 data.

# Merge df_17 with df_15 Region column on 'Country'
df_17_with_region = pd.merge(
    df_17_renamed,
    df_15_renamed[['Country', 'Region']],
    on='Country',
    how='left'
)

# Now merge df_15_renamed and df_17_with_region on 'Country' to combine all columns
# We already have Region in df_15_renamed, so we can merge on Country and Region to be safe
# But Region might be missing in df_17_with_region for some countries, so merge on Country only

df_target = pd.merge(
    df_15_renamed,
    df_17_with_region.drop(columns=['Region']),  # drop Region to avoid duplication
    on='Country',
    how='inner',
    suffixes=('_15', '_17')  # suffixes won't be used because columns already renamed
)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Country', 'Region',
    'Happiness_Rank_15', 'Happiness_Score_15', 'Standard_Error_15', 'Economy_15', 'Family_15',
    'Life_Expectancy_15', 'Freedom_15', 'Trust_15', 'Generosity_15', 'Dystopia_15',
    'Happiness_Rank_17', 'Happiness_Score_17', 'Whisker_High_17', 'Whisker_Low_17',
    'Economy_17', 'Family_17', 'Life_Expectancy_17', 'Freedom_17', 'Generosity_17',
    'Trust_17', 'Dystopia_17'
]

# Some countries might be missing in one source or the other, so inner join ensures only common countries.
# Check if all target columns exist in df_target
missing_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in df_target.columns]
if missing_cols:
    raise ValueError(f"Missing columns in merged dataframe: {missing_cols}")

df_target = df_target[target_columns]

# Convert data types to match target schema
df_target = df_target.astype({
    'Country': str,
    'Region': str,
    'Happiness_Rank_15': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_15': float,
    'Standard_Error_15': float,
    'Economy_15': float,
    'Family_15': float,
    'Life_Expectancy_15': float,
    'Freedom_15': float,
    'Trust_15': float,
    'Generosity_15': float,
    'Dystopia_15': float,
    'Happiness_Rank_17': 'Int64',
    'Happiness_Score_17': float,
    'Whisker_High_17': float,
    'Whisker_Low_17': float,
    'Economy_17': float,
    'Family_17': float,
    'Life_Expectancy_17': float,
    'Freedom_17': float,
    'Generosity_17': float,
    'Trust_17': float,
    'Dystopia_17': float
})

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_79/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
